summary: Complete testing of Currency Management feature. Backend: 18/18 tests passed. Frontend: All features working correctly including Currency Management page, enable/disable toggles, Add Exchange Rate modal, Currency Converter modal, and currency selector in Create Invoice modal.

GET /api/invoice/config/currencies.details: Returns currencies list with base_currency, enabled_currencies, and currency details (code, name_en, name_ar, symbol)

POST /api/invoice/config/exchange-rates.details: Successfully adds exchange rate with to_currency, rate, effective_date

GET /api/invoice/config/convert.details: Converts 1000 EGP to USD correctly using exchange rate

GET /api/invoice/parties.details: Returns customers list for invoice creation

POST /api/invoice/ (with USD currency).details: Successfully creates invoice with USD currency

currencies_page_load.details: Currency Management page loads with title, stats cards, currency table, exchange rates table

stats_cards.details: Shows Base Currency (EGP), Total Currencies (5-6 enabled), Active Rates (1)

currency_settings_table.details: Shows 11 currencies with Code, Name, Symbol, Enabled toggle, Base Currency button

currency_toggle.details: Toggle enables/disables currencies, updates Total Currencies count, shows 'Set as Base' button for enabled currencies

set_as_base_button.details: Button visible for enabled non-base currencies

exchange_rates_table.details: Shows Currency, Exchange Rate (1 EGP = X), Effective Date, Actions (delete)

add_exchange_rate_modal.details: Modal opens with Currency dropdown, Exchange Rate input, Effective Date picker, Cancel/Save buttons

currency_converter_modal.details: Modal opens with Amount input, From/To currency dropdowns, Convert button, Result display with exchange rate

converter_calculation.details: 5000 EGP converts to 102 USD using rate 0.0204

invoice_currency_selector.details: Create Invoice modal shows Currency dropdown with all enabled currencies (EGP, USD, EUR, SAR, AED, GBP)

invoice_with_usd.details: Invoice INV-2026-00002 created with 114 USD visible in invoices list

seed_data_creation: Created test invoice with USD currency (INV-2026-00002), added exchange rates for USD (0.0204) and EUR (0.019)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Currency Management feature fully tested. CurrenciesPage.jsx is accessed via E-Invoices > Currencies in sidebar. Backend endpoints: GET/PUT /api/invoice/config/currencies, GET/POST/DELETE /api/invoice/config/exchange-rates, GET /api/invoice/config/convert. InvoicesPage.jsx has currency selector in Create Invoice modal (lines 750-765). 11 currencies available: EGP, USD, EUR, SAR, AED, GBP, KWD, QAR, BHD, OMR. Default enabled: EGP, USD, EUR, SAR, AED.
